ambient: The evening goes on being one.
You consider standing up, and file the consideration.
Something in the room settles, at length.
description: A chair in the middle of an ordinary evening, and getting out of it is a project you have deferred. Everything you need is within reach of somebody who was willing to reach. The television is off and the room is doing all of the work.
name: The Long Sit

looks: It has taken your shape and it has no plans.
Standing up out of it is a sequence of about nine separate things.
It is not comfortable exactly. It has been agreed with.
objects.name: the chair

looks: It carries on being an evening without any help from you.
Everything in it is four feet further away than it was.
It will still be doing this in an hour. So will you.
objects.name: the room

weather: It is the temperature of a room somebody heated hours ago and then left.
